summary: Neumora Therapeutics disclosed a 35% workforce reduction due to navacaprant discontinuation and amended its loan agreement to extend the interest-only period and revise liquidity covenants. The Third Amendment with K2 HealthVentures ties minimum liquidity to operational milestones and market cap (50%-110% of obligations or waived). The RIF and loan modifications indicate a strategic pivot amid pipeline restructuring. Watch for further clinical updates, compliance with covenants, and potential asset sales or additional financing to support operations.
